items.summaryZh: 安东内利在墨西哥城大奖赛锁定世界冠军后，托托·沃尔夫回应了自己在梅赛德斯的未来，称他每天都在评估自己的去留，并自嘲是“恐龙”，同时为继任者做准备。

items.originalTitle: Toto Wolff addresses his future at Mercedes after momentous Kimi Antonelli win
items.summaryEn: After Kimi Antonelli clinched the world championship at the Mexico City Grand Prix, Toto Wolff addressed his own future at Mercedes, saying he evaluates it daily, calls himself a dinosaur and is preparing his eventual successor.
detailZh: 托托·沃尔夫谈安东内利夺冠后自己在梅赛德斯的未来
托托·沃尔夫承认他每天都在评估自己在梅赛德斯的未来，自嘲是“恐龙”，同时为最终的继任者做准备。
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
为一位20岁的世界冠军加冕，正是那种足以定义 legacy、迫使一位高管评估自己长期未来的成就。对托托·沃尔夫而言，这种评估是每天的例行公事。
在基米·安东内利于墨西哥城大奖赛历史性地锁定冠军后，这位奥地利高管不可避免地面临关于他自己在布拉克利车队掌舵 longevity 的问题。一位围场记者尖锐地将其与2016年相提并论，指出梅赛德斯上一次加冕首位冠军时，尼科·罗斯伯格在几天后震惊世界地宣布退役。
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯
当被问及安东内利的年轻活力是否鼓励他继续留在维修区墙边，还是最终将接力棒交给新鲜血液时，这位54岁的高管给出了他对自己的退出策略的评估。
“我每天都在反思，并问自己，我是在为车队的发展做出贡献，无论好坏？”他在赛后的媒体职责中透露。“如果我感觉不够好，或者有人能做得更好，我会是第一个说我要退居一旁的人，我将担任执行主席，并告诉每个人他们应该如何做得更好。”
自沃尔夫于2013年最初接管银箭车队以来，现代一级方程式赛车的格局已大幅扩张。面对残酷的24站赛历、艰难的成本上限生态以及巨大的企业需求，这位梅赛德斯车队老板承认，传统的车队领队角色对一个人来说完全不可持续。
“我认为那些领队就像恐龙一样——我也慢慢开始觉得自己有点像他们了——那是不同的结构，”他解释道。“那是一个代表车队的人，与赞助商一起清点装备，参与赛车事务，在政治上与国际汽联或FOM以及其他车队建立关系。”
安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯，托托·沃尔夫，梅赛德斯，安德鲁·肖夫林，梅赛德斯
为了在未来生存下去，这位亿万富翁共同所有者确认，他最终的继任者将不会是一个人。
他表示：“我认为，几年之后这支车队的未来将在很大程度上是分工明确的角色。”
尽管正式勾勒了车队未来的企业架构，沃尔夫完全排除了任何立即退休的传言。不过，他正在闭门大力将大量日常运营事务分派出去。
他特别赞扬了长期担任传播总监的布拉德利·洛德挺身而出承担运营重担。洛德在维修区已成为一个日益显眼且有权势的人物，成功管理了安东内利竞选活动中密集的媒体与结构性后勤工作。
布拉德利·洛德，梅赛德斯副车队负责人
他指出：“我想继续担任我的角色……把布拉德利提拔上来，他帮我分担了很多以前让我烦心或工作量很大的事情。”这位车队领队特意强调，洛德“比我勤奋得多，也更有条理”。
尽管工厂里显然正在为一次重大交接奠定基础，但竞争对手车队不应指望这位传奇管理者很快就会放下耳机。
他微笑着总结道：“我不打算就此收工。”
detailEn: Toto Wolff addresses his future at Mercedes after momentous Kimi Antonelli win
Toto Wolff admits he evaluates his Mercedes future daily, calling himself a dinosaur while preparing his eventual successor
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

Crowning a 20-year-old World Champion is exactly the kind of legacy-defining achievement that forces an executive to evaluate their long-term future. For Toto Wolff, that evaluation is a daily routine.

Following Kimi Antonelli's historic title clinch at the Mexico City Grand Prix, the Austrian executive faced inevitable questions about his own longevity at the helm of the Brackley squad. A paddock journalist drew a sharp parallel to 2016, noting that the last time Mercedes crowned a first-time champion, Nico Rosberg shocked the world by retiring just days later.
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes
Asked if Antonelli's youthful energy encourages him to stay on the pitwall or finally pass the baton to fresh blood, the 54-year-old delivered his assessment of his exit strategy.

"I’m reflecting every day and saying, am I contributing to this to the team’s development in the good and the bad?" he revealed during his post-race media duties. "If I feel that it’s not as good or there’s someone that could do it better, I would be the first one to say I’m doing a step to the side, I’m going to be executive chairman and tell everyone how they should do it better."

The modern Formula 1 landscape has aggressively expanded since Wolff originally took charge of the Silver Arrows in 2013. With a brutal 24-race calendar, a difficult cost cap ecosystem, and massive corporate demands, the Mercedes boss acknowledges that the traditional team principal role is completely unsustainable for one person.

"I think the dinosaurs of the principals—and I slowly start to feel a little bit like them—it was different structures," he explained. "It was one guy representing the team, doing the gear counting with the sponsors, being involved in the racing, having the relationships politically with the FIA or FOM, the other teams."
Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes, Toto Wolff, Mercedes, Andrew Shovlin, Mercedes
To survive in the future, the billionaire co-owner confirmed that his eventual replacement will not be a single individual.
"I think very much the future of this team a few years down the line is going to be split roles," he stated.

Despite formally outlining the future corporate structure of the team, Wolff is entirely shutting down any immediate retirement rumours. He is, however, aggressively delegating massive chunks of his daily operations behind closed doors.

He specifically praised long-time Communications Director Bradley Lord for stepping up to shoulder the operational burden. Lord has become an increasingly visible and powerful figure in the garage, successfully managing the intense media and structural logistics of the Antonelli campaign.
Bradley Lord, Mercedes Deputy Team Principal

"I want to continue in my role... bringing Bradley up, who's taking so many things off me that previously annoyed me, or that were a lot of work," he noted. The team boss went out of his way to highlight that Lord is "much more diligent than me and structured".
While the groundwork for a massive transition is clearly being laid out at the factory, rival teams should not expect the legendary manager to vacate his headset anytime soon.
"I don't plan to call it a day," he concluded with a smile.

items.titleZh: 奥康永久离开哈斯车队，卡马拉巴西站首秀——我们的看法
items.summaryZh: 奥康因在墨西哥站的周末中途被替换而提前离开哈斯车队，2027年车手拉斐尔·卡马拉将在本周巴西站迎来F1首秀。哈斯车队为何选择卡马拉在家乡站参赛而非在墨西哥站的得分新秀永井大翔？
items.originalTitle: Our verdict on Ocon's permanent Haas exit - and Camara's debut
detailZh: 奥康在墨西哥站周末比赛中被突然换下后，提前被解约，他将不再为哈斯车队参赛，2027年的车手Rafael Camara将在本周的巴西大奖赛中首次亮相一级方程式。
我们对奥康的困境、哈斯车队的事态以及决定让Camara在本届巴西大奖赛中而不是墨西哥站的得分新秀Ryo Hirakawa驾驶赛车的决定有何看法。
我相信哈斯车队在给Camara一个早期的F1首秀方面做出了正确的选择——但这将是一场地狱般的洗礼。
Camara还没有参加过FP1，这将是他F1周末的首秀。
他曾在私人测试中为哈斯和法拉利车队驾驶，所以他并不是完全陌生的，但周末比赛的压 力非常不同——这将是他在现实生活中第一次接触2026年机械的真实体验，因为那些测试是在旧车上进行的。
除此之外：这是卡马拉的主场赛事。
去年，正处于一个稳健的新秀赛季中的加布里埃尔·博尔特奥托，在那种压力下真的很挣扎。
哦，而且目前预报周末将有大量降雨。
所以，在这样的环境下首次亮相是非常困难的。
但哈斯选择卡玛拉参加2027赛季，有非常好的理由。他的适应能力和对赛道的自然感觉使他能够立即提供速度——正如他在波尔蒂马奥的‘对决’中所做的那样，这场对决为他赢得了这个席位——这可以帮助他在这周末克服所有这些困难。
尽管在个人层面上我喜欢奥康，我觉得他现在的情况非常令人难过，但我从未觉得他的困境在公众舆论中引发了多数人的支持。
现在我看到越来越多的极端和不准确的假设或声明被用来支持他，以及批评哈斯，尽管如此，但我感到有必要挑战这些，即使这可能让我看起来像是哈斯的同情者。
它没有在奥康加入车队的前两年为他做得足够好，但我并不认为哈斯车队将他置于困境。因为数据上并没有显示车辆的不一致或性能差异，所以车队驳回了奥康关于这些问题的投诉。今年出现的问题不同了，哈斯车队可以看到它未能解决的问题。
然而，我真的无法支持的是，哈斯车队方便地操纵了墨西哥发生的事情，以便提前从付费车手中获利。这对哈斯车队来说非常不方便。
如果金钱是这里的优先事项，那么通过支付奥康的费用或让车队面临违约的法律风险来将他排除在外，同时通过更换第二辆车的车手来损害车队在锦标赛中锁定数百万美元位置的机会，这是没有意义的。
Hirakawa在墨西哥表现不错，但他得到的分数非常幸运。Camara可能成为一名非常优秀的F1车手——我认为他是明年一个出色的意外之选——但他严重缺乏所需的准备和了解哈斯F1赛车的知识，以便在本赛季立即成为奥康的升级。
我简直无法想象除了哈斯车队和车队总监小川明夫感到他们的手被逼得无处可去之外，还有其他任何原因会导致这种情况发生，对他们来说，在竞争方面最好的短期和长期策略就是尽快摆脱奥康，重新开始。
给年轻车手一个机会
我一直都是年轻车手的粉丝，并支持给他们机会。奥康已经得到了他的机会，是的，他赢得了一场比赛（有点运气），但总体来说，他的表现并不令人印象深刻。他与任何队友的赛道关系都值得怀疑，而他被告知将被替换后的态度更是证实了这一点。
说‘我应属于F1’是一个很大的声明——没有人‘应属于’F1；表现和潜力应该让你在那里，并让你保持在那里，但无论他的情况如何，他在墨西哥练习中与车队关于轮胎分配的口头争执只是压垮棺材的最后一根钉子。
在过去的几个赛季中，我们很高兴地看到了许多新车手的加入：奥斯卡·皮亚斯蒂、奥利·贝尔曼、博托莱托、阿维德·林德布拉德和基米·安东内利，仅举几个例子。是的，不出所料，一些人在第一个赛季中遇到了困难，安东内利就是一个典型的例子，但他今年通过有说服力地赢得世界冠军证明了自己的潜力。
卡马拉是下一个要加入这个名单的人。给他一个早些时候的开始来准备他2027赛季的到来是一个积极的决定。他可以了解F1周末的复杂性，然后有整个冬天的时间来消化这个情况，我相信这将使他在准备方面处于更好的位置。
他需要从其他新秀车手和他们的第一个赛季中学习，并以此为鉴，因为罗马不是一天建成的。
更重要的是，尽量不要像安东内利在他在蒙扎的第一场新秀FP1比赛中撞上护栏时那样做！要逐步适应，如果哈斯能提供所需的赛车，那么天空才是极限——正如基米在2026年所证明的那样。
我们缺少一些关键细节，但从已经公开的信息来看，哈斯在整个过程中都表现出了极高的专业性。
对于发布这样消息的团队来说，通过这种方式获得道德制高点很容易，但从哈斯发布的声明和其中小松的话中可以看出，他们不得不长时间深思熟虑才能决定让奥康提前离队的结果。
如果将比较（非常）业余的体育运动，有一件事让我印象深刻，那就是F1车手在战斗激烈和战斗后的即时情况下能够保持冷静。
想象一下，在足球比赛中，你向罚球区前进，却被对方拉倒，而且是一对一的情况下对方球员没有被出示黄牌；你接下来最想做的就是给对方一个回击——或者至少对这种不公正进行抱怨。
这种比较并不是为了在这个场景中提供一个完美的报复性一对一比较，而是用来展示在这样的高风险情况下，驾驶舱内所发生的司机们设法不做出反应的挫败感。通常，为了他们所代表的那些人的更大利益，司机们往往能够做到这一点。
奥康在墨西哥周五的无线电信息听起来非常不舒服。是的，这是一个为了自己的生计而战斗的车手。但他仍然是他所受雇的团队的代表。被迫失业，或者想要离开，你需要给任何潜在的雇主留下最好的印象。
奥康的最后一周并没有足够的内容来成为他职业生涯的救命稻草，以防止他的一级方程式职业生涯可能结束的情况。这看起来更可能是最终的结束——以一种非常悲伤的方式，考虑到他所取得的成就。
哈斯需要非常小心地管理这种动态。
卡马拉在F1的黄金时期加入，刘易斯·汉密尔顿已经让法拉利的车手晋升计划陷入僵局，并表示他觉得自己可以一直赛车到2030年代。
如果他真的做到了，那将会是一个很长的等待，因为比阿曼在2024年首次亮相时，看起来就像是法拉利的未来之星。
哈斯需要做的是阻止哈斯F1车队陷入‘谁将取代刘易斯·汉密尔顿’的困境。
卡马拉将对自己有信心，并相信他足够优秀，可以代表法拉利赛车，正如他应该的那样。
贝尔曼会觉得自己在法拉利的座位旁边是应得的，并且不太可能对有人试图抓住这个机会感到高兴。
也许他们会为了共同的目标而和谐地工作，为了团队的利益。但不可否认，从纸面上看，这是一套风险极高的阵容，具有重大影响。车队必须控制住绝望、决心和自我，以支持哈斯的成功，就像支持这些年轻车手一样。
detailEn: Esteban Ocon will not race for Haas again after being axed prematurely following his shock mid-weekend benching in Mexico, with 2027 driver Rafael Camara making his Formula 1 debut in Brazil this week.
This is what we make of Ocon's plight, the fallout at Haas, and the decision to put Camara in the car at his home race instead of Mexico's point-scoring debutant Ryo Hirakawa again.
I believe Haas has made the right choice in giving Camara an early F1 debut - but it's going to be one hell of a baptism of fire.
Camara hasn't done an FP1 yet so this will be his F1 weekend debut.

He has driven for Haas and Ferrari in private tests so he's not coming in completely cold but the pressure of a race weekend is very different - and this will be his first taste of 2026 machinery in real-life given those tests were in old cars.
Then on top of all of that: this is Camara's home race.
Gabriel Bortoleto, who was deep into a solid rookie season, really struggled under the weight of that pressure last year.
Oh, and there's currently plenty of rain forecast for the weekend.
So it's an enormously difficult set of circumstances to be making your debut in.

But Haas picked Camara for 2027 for very good reasons. His adaptability and natural feel for the conditions that enables him to instantly deliver speed - as he did in the Portimao 'shootout' that won him the seat - could help him overcome all of that this weekend.
Much as on a personal level I like Ocon and I find it very sad that it's come to this, I've never felt that his plight has triggered majority support in the court of public opinion.

I have now seen more and more extreme and inaccurate assumptions or declarations being made in support of him and as criticism of Haas, though, which I feel compelled to challenge even at the risk of being seen as a Haas sympathiser.

It has not done a good enough job for Ocon in his two years with the team, but I don't believe Haas hung him out to dry. It rebuffed Ocon's complaints about car inconsistencies or performance discrepancies because they didn't exist on the data - this year the problems are different, and Haas can see issues it has failed to resolve.
The narrative I really can't get behind, though, is that Haas is conveniently manipulating whatever happened in Mexico, to cash in early on pay drivers. This is thoroughly inconvenient for Haas.

If money's the priority here, it doesn't make sense to park Ocon by paying him off or leaving the team vulnerable to legal action for breach of contract - AND at the same time hurt its chances of sealing a multi-million dollar position in the championship by chopping and changing who is in the second car.

Hirakawa did well in Mexico but the point he scored was very fortunate. And Camara could be a very good F1 driver - I think he's an excellent wildcard option for next year - but is sorely lacking the kind of preparation needed and the knowledge of Haas's F1 car needed to come in and immediately be an upgrade on Ocon this season.

I just can't imagine a scenario in which this plays out for any reason other than Haas and team principal Ayao Komatsu feeling their hand's been forced, and that the best short-term and long-term play for the team competitively is to just get rid of Ocon and start fresh as soon as possible.
Better to give a young driver the chance

I have always been a fan of young drivers and giving them a chance. Ocon has had his and yes he won a race (with a bit of luck), but in general his performances have been unimpressive. His on-track relationship with any of his team-mates has been questionable and his attitude after being told he was being replaced just confirms this.

To say 'I deserve to be in F1' is a big statement - nobody 'deserves' to be in F1; performance and potential should get you and keep you there, but no matter what his situation his verbal altercation with his team about his tyre allocation in practice in Mexico was just the nail in the coffin.

In the last few seasons thankfully we have seen lots of new drivers: Oscar Piastri, Ollie Bearman, Bortoleto, Arvid Lindblad and Kimi Antonelli to name but a few. Yes, some unsurprisingly have struggled in the first season and Antonelli is a prime example, but he has proved his potential by convincingly winning the world championship this year.

Camara is the next to add to that list. Giving him an early start to prepare him for the 2027 season is a positive decision. He can learn about the intricacies of an F1 race weekend and then have the winter to digest the situation and I am sure it will put him in a better place preparation-wise.
He needs to learn from the other debut drivers and their first seasons and use this as an example that Rome wasn't built in a day.

More importantly, try your best to not do an Antonelli when he threw it into the barrier in Monza in his first rookie FP1 appearance! Just build into it and if Haas can supply the car required then the sky's the limit - as Kimi has just proven in 2026.
We are short of some crucial details but, from those that have been afforded, Haas has acted with the utmost professionalism throughout all of this.

It's very easy for a team releasing such news to gain the moral high ground by extension but it is evident from Haas's statement, and Komatsu's words in it, that it had to deliberate long and hard over this outcome of Ocon being released early.

If the comparison to (very) amateur sports allows, one thing that has always impressed me beyond comprehension is how composed F1 drivers are able to remain in the heat of battle and in the immediate aftermath of it.

Imagine, if you will, advancing on the penalty box in a football game, just to be dragged down, while one-on-one, and not have your opposing player carded; the very next thing you want to do is have a pop at said opponent - or at the very least rant about the injustice.

The comparison is not meant to serve as a perfect retaliatory like-for-like in this scenario, but it's drawn to illustrate the level of frustration, in such high-stakes situations, that goes on in the cockpit that drivers somehow manage to resist without reaction. Often, for the greater good of those they are representing.

Ocon's radio message on Friday in Mexico made for a deeply uncomfortable listen. Yes, this is a driver fighting for his individual livelihood. But he is still a representative of the team he's employed by. Forced out of a job, or looking to leave, you need to give off the best impression possible to any prospective employers out there.

What's turned out to be Ocon's final few weeks have not had enough of that about them to be a career lifeline and prevent what could be the end of his F1 career. This seems much more likely to be a definitive end - in a really sad way, considering what's been accomplished.
Haas needs to manage this dynamic very, very carefully.
Camara comes into an F1 at an absolutely pivotal stage. Lewis Hamilton has caused a log-jam in the Ferrari driver graduation scheme and has said he feels he could race into the 2030s.
If he does, that will feel like a very long time since Bearman made his debut in 2024 and looked like Ferrari's bright future.
What Haas has to do is to stop the Haas F1 team descending into the 'who will replace Lewis Hamilton' team.
Camara will be confident in his own ability and believe he's good enough to race for Ferrari, as he should.
Bearman will feel he's earned the seat next to Leclerc at Ferrari, and likely won't take kindly to someone trying to take that opportunity.

Maybe they take this shared goal and work harmoniously for the good of the team. But you can't deny, on paper, this is a risky line-up with massive implications. The team has to contain the desperation, determination and egos involved to support Haas's success as much as these young drivers.

items.summaryEn: McLaren team principal Andrea Stella said a disastrous qualifying session and dirty air cost the team its chance of a podium at the Mexico City Grand Prix.
detailZh: 安德烈亚·斯特拉解释排位赛如何毁掉迈凯伦的墨西哥站：“我们付出了代价”
安德烈亚·斯特拉将糟糕的排位赛和脏空气归咎为毁掉迈凯伦在墨西哥城大奖赛领奖台机会的原因
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦
致迈凯伦车迷。来自沃金的木瓜色新闻，带来车手、赛车、车队策略以及每个比赛周末的最新消息。
拥有一辆有实力登上领奖台的车，如果你71圈都绝望地困在乱流中，那意义就小得多了。
这就是迈凯伦在墨西哥城大奖赛上的现实。艰难的周六排位赛让沃金车库完全处于被动，彻底抵消了其赛车纯粹的比赛速度。因为高海拔的稀薄空气让散热成为噩梦，也让空气动力学上跟随另一辆车变得极其困难，所以在墨西哥，赛道位置就是王道。
兰多·诺里斯整个下午都困在DRS车阵中，在对手的乱流尾流里消耗着轮胎。
“至于我们今天的表现，比赛证实了我们本有登上领奖台的潜力，”车队领队安德烈亚·斯特拉在格子旗挥动后解释道。“不幸的是，我们为两位车手的发车格位置以及技术规则带来的限制付出了代价，这些限制让在这条赛道上超车几乎不可能。”
夏尔·勒克莱尔，法拉利，兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯
这位意大利车队老板毫不掩饰这段赛程对他的头号车手来说有多么煎熬，后者整场比赛都紧盯着前车的变速箱。
“兰多花了那么多时间在尾流里——先是跟在拉塞尔后面，然后跟在勒克莱尔后面——我觉得他现在闭着眼睛都能画出他们赛车的尾部了！”他开玩笑说。
这个下午在木瓜色车库的另一侧同样令人恼火。奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里正忙于在中场执行一次非常高效的追赶，直到与阿尔维德·林德布拉德有争议的纠缠突然中断了他的前进势头。
国际汽联干事调查了这次接触，并对这位澳大利亚车手处以时间处罚，使英国车队损失了关键积分。
“此外，奥斯卡因与林德布拉德的接触而受到的严厉处罚让我们又损失了宝贵的积分，”迈凯伦车队领队感叹道。“这真的很遗憾，因为奥斯卡本来已经完成了一次漂亮的追赶。”
在墨西哥丢掉的这些积分有着巨大的经济分量。迈凯伦目前正与红牛车队陷入一场激烈、高风险的争夺，目标是车队积分榜第三名。
在三连赛最后一站之前，迈凯伦落后这支米尔顿凯恩斯车队17分，斯特拉正带着重磅武器前往巴西，以缩小差距。
兰多·诺里斯，迈凯伦，奥斯卡·皮亚斯特里，迈凯伦
他承认：“今天在与红牛争夺第三名的战斗中，在一节让我们陷入困境的排位赛之后，我们只能限制损失。我们需要追回17分，但我相信，凭借我们今天展现的速度以及下周在巴西带来的升级，我们完全有机会至少实现这个目标。”
在英特拉格斯超越红牛不会凭空发生。如果沃金车队想要锁定第三名以及随之而来的巨额奖金，就必须停止在周六犯错。
正如斯特拉直白地警告他的车库：“然而，要做到这一点，我们作为一个团队必须在各个方面都做到完美。”
detailEn: Andrea Stella explains how qualifying destroyed McLaren’s Mexico GP: “We paid the price”
Andrea Stella blames a disastrous qualifying and dirty air for ruining McLaren's podium chances at the Mexico City GP
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren
For McLaren fans. Papaya news from Woking, with the latest on the drivers, the car, team strategy and every race weekend.
Having a podium-capable car means much less if you spend 71 laps hopelessly trapped in dirty air.

That was the reality for McLaren at the Mexico City Grand Prix. A difficult Saturday qualifying session left the Woking garage entirely on the back foot, completely negating the raw race pace of its machinery. Because the thin air at high altitude makes cooling a nightmare and aerodynamically following another car incredibly difficult, track position is king in Mexico.
Lando Norris spent his entire afternoon stuck in a DRS train, burning up his tyres in the turbulent wake of his rivals.

“As for our performance today, the race confirmed that we had the potential to finish on the podium,” team principal Andrea Stella explained after the chequered flag. “Unfortunately, we paid the price for both our drivers’ starting grid positions and the limitations imposed by the technical regulations, which make overtaking practically impossible on a track like this."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren, George Russell, Mercedes
The Italian team boss did not hold back on just how agonising the stint was for his lead driver, who spent the entire race staring directly at gearboxes.
"With all the time Lando spent in the slipstream – first behind Russell and then behind Leclerc – I think he could now draw the rear of their cars with his eyes closed!” he joked.

The afternoon was equally infuriating on the other side of the papaya-coloured garage. Oscar Piastri was busy executing a highly effective recovery drive through the midfield before a controversial tangle with Arvid Lindblad abruptly halted his progress.
The FIA stewards investigated the contact and slapped the Australian with a time penalty, bleeding crucial points away from the British squad.
“Furthermore, the harsh penalty Oscar received for the contact with Lindblad cost us further valuable points," the McLaren chief lamented. "A real shame because Oscar had staged a good comeback."
Those dropped points in Mexico carry massive financial weight. McLaren is currently locked in a bitter, high-stakes dogfight with Red Bull Racing for third place in the Constructors' Championship.
With McLaren trailing the Milton Keynes outfit by 17 points heading into the final leg of the triple-header, Stella is bringing serious heavy artillery to Brazil to close the gap.
Lando Norris, McLaren, Oscar Piastri, McLaren

“In our battle with Red Bull for third place today, we could only limit the damage after a Qualifying session that had put us in a difficult position," he admitted. “We have 17 points to make up, but I believe that with the pace we showed today and the upgrades coming to Brazil next week, we have every chance of achieving at least that target."
Eclipsing Red Bull at Interlagos won't happen by accident. If the Woking squad wants to secure P3 and the massive prize money that comes with it, it has to stop making Saturday mistakes.
As Stella bluntly warned his garage: “To do so, however, we’ll have to be perfect as a team, in every respect.”

detailZh: 查尔斯·勒克莱尔淡然面对与刘易斯·汉密尔顿的碰撞：“我也有可能不开心”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔谈论他在墨西哥城大奖赛第一圈与队友刘易斯·汉密尔顿的碰撞以及随之而来的处罚
对于法拉利车迷来说。最新的Scuderia 法拉利 F1新闻，车手更新，技术分析和来自马拉内洛及更远处的比赛反应
墨西哥城大奖赛的开局圈出现了法拉利车队内部的激烈战斗。
在争夺比赛领头的战斗中，查尔斯·勒克莱尔和刘易斯·汉密尔顿在弯道序列的开头阶段进行了激烈的对抗。这两辆鲜红色的赛车相互挤压到了极限，最终导致勒克莱尔车手偏离赛道并受到了时间处罚。
汉密尔顿最初在1号弯道迫使他的队友向外行驶，但真正的戏剧性事件在几分钟后在4号弯道爆发。两人车轮并行深入刹车区，导致两位车手完全错过了弯道顶端。29岁的年轻人没有将位置让给这位七届世界冠军，而是继续全力加速。随之而来的混乱无意中让红牛的马克斯·维斯塔潘得以从沮丧的英国人身边滑过。
意识到因离开赛道并获得优势而可能面临体育处罚，这位来自马拉内洛的车手询问了他的维修区，但最终选择在赛道上坚持自己的立场。
勒克莱尔在赛后媒体采访中承认说：“是的，我的意思是，处罚是应该的。问题是有点令人困惑，因为我们俩都没有通过4号弯道。然后我领先，然后马克斯超过了刘易斯。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，兰多·诺里斯，麦克拉伦，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
战略性地防御红牛在他的瞬间决定接受惩罚中发挥了巨大作用。
“然后我问自己应该做什么，我保持了位置。我接受了应有的处罚，”他解释道。“我不知道刘易斯的点是不是为了让我获得第三名，但至少有红牛的第二名，我觉得保持位置并看看会发生什么是值得的。这就是我做的。”
时间处罚并不是他下午的唯一障碍。在第45圈红旗暂停了练习后，接下来的重启对法拉利车手的领奖台希望来说非常残酷。他在尘土飞扬、没有橡胶的一侧排列在起跑线上，他挣扎着寻找抓地力，最终让梅赛德斯新秀基米·安东内利完成了对第三名的临床超越。
“第一节的节奏真的很不错，整体来说，我认为节奏也很强，但不幸的是，在第二次发车时，我们在赛道较脏的一侧遇到了一些困难，”法拉利的车手指出。“赛道并不那么干净，但这就是它的样子。”
查尔斯·勒克莱尔，法拉利，刘易斯·汉密尔顿，法拉利
汉密尔顿在车队无线电中对4号弯道的事故非常愤怒，要求维修区给出解释。当被问及是否会在私下与队友和解时，勒克莱尔对激烈的比赛态度毫无歉意，直接指责汉密尔顿在开赛角的攻击性。
“好吧，我会和刘易斯谈谈，”他耸了耸肩。“我也可以对他在1号弯道将我推离赛道表示不满，但我觉得这就是赛车。当你为了胜利而战斗时，这就是应该的方式。”
detailEn: Charles Leclerc brushes off Lewis Hamilton clash: “I could be unhappy too”
Charles Leclerc addresses his lap 1 clash with team-mate Lewis Hamilton and the resulting penalty at the Mexico City GP
For Ferrari fans. The latest Scuderia Ferrari F1 news, driver updates, technical analysis and race reaction from Maranello and beyond.
The opening lap of the Mexico City Grand Prix featured an intense, intra-team battle within Ferrari.

Battling for the race lead, Charles Leclerc and Lewis Hamilton traded heavy, aggressive blows through the opening sequence of corners. The scarlet cars squeezed each other to the absolute limit, ultimately resulting in an off-track excursion and a time penalty for the Monegasque driver.

Hamilton initially forced his team-mate wide through the Turn 1 complex, but the real drama erupted moments later at Turn 4. The pair went wheel-to-wheel deep into the braking zone, causing both drivers to miss the apex entirely. Instead of yielding the position back to the seven-time world champion, the 29-year-old kept his foot down. The resulting chaos inadvertently allowed Red Bull’s Max Verstappen to slip past the frustrated Brit.
Knowing a sporting sanction was likely imminent for leaving the track and gaining an advantage, the Maranello charger queried his pitwall but ultimately chose to hold his ground on the asphalt.

"Yes, I mean, the penalty was deserved in a way," Leclerc admitted during his post-race media availability. "The thing is that it was a bit confusing because we both didn't make Turn 4. Then I stayed ahead, and then Max got past Lewis."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lando Norris, McLaren, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
Strategic defence against Red Bull played a massive role in his split-second decision to take the punishment.

"Then I asked what should I do, and I kept the position. I took a deserved penalty," he explained. "I don't know if Lewis's point was for me to get P3, but at least having a Red Bull second, I felt it was worth it to kind of keep the position and see what happens. That's what I did."

The time penalty was not his only hurdle of the afternoon. After the Lap 45 red flag halted the session, the ensuing restart proved brutal for the Ferrari driver's podium hopes. Lining up on the dusty, un-rubbered side of the grid, he struggled for traction, ultimately allowing Mercedes rookie Kimi Antonelli to execute a clinical pass for third place.

"The pace was really good on the first stint, and the pace overall, I think, was quite strong, but unfortunately, coming the second start on the dirty side of the track, we struggled quite a bit," the Ferrari driver noted. "The track wasn't so clean, but it's the way it is."
Charles Leclerc, Ferrari, Lewis Hamilton, Ferrari

Hamilton was noticeably furious over the team radio regarding the Turn 4 incident, demanding answers from the pitwall. When asked about smoothing things over with his team-mate behind closed doors, Leclerc remained entirely unapologetic about the hard racing, pointing a finger right back at Hamilton's opening-corner aggression.

"Well, I'll speak with Lewis," he shrugged. "I could be also unhappy with how much he pushed me off the track out of Turn 1, but I think it's racing. When you are fighting for a win, it's the way it should be."

凯迪拉克测试车手科尔顿·赫塔将在本周末的圣保罗大奖赛中进行他的第六次周五练习，以收集他参加F1赛事所需的缺失的FIA超级驾照积分。
赫塔，通过私人测试、FP1练习和一场混乱的F2赛季来为F1赛事做准备，他需要40分才能获得所需的FIA超级驾照。凯迪拉克认为这位前印第安纳波利斯500英里赛冠军车手上周在墨西哥已经达到了积分门槛，但很快发现加利福尼亚人仍然差一分，因为对他的之前印第安纳波利斯500英里赛结果存在混淆。
凯迪拉克将纠正这一错误，通过让赫塔再次在塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯的车中参加另一个周五FP1练习，这将为车队赢得一分。车队每年只需要让一名新秀参加四次FP1练习，但圣保罗将是赫塔本赛季的第六次FP1练习，因为车队渴望赫塔最终获得执照。
这使车队在考虑保留现任车手瓦尔特里·博塔斯与佩雷斯一起续约第二年，或者让赫塔在2027年首次参加F1比赛时保持选择权。
"我非常期待再次驾驶MAC-26赛车参加另一个FP1练习，"赫塔说。"英特拉戈斯是一个非常标志性的、历史悠久的赛道，在那里驾驶F1赛车将是一次令人兴奋的经历。
"今年我每次上车，从巴塞罗那到布达佩斯，COTA和墨西哥城，我都感到越来越舒适，与工程团队的合作也越来越好。我在巴西周五上午的目标是相同的：干净利落地执行练习计划，为Checo和工程师们提供最好的设置数据，以开始他们的周末，并继续在赛车中取得进步。我感谢车队给我这个机会。"
凯迪拉克车队在墨西哥周末的激烈比赛中遭遇重创后，前往巴西，而这次周末的赛事以博塔斯因突然的前左悬挂故障而发生的速度事故告终。车队负责人马尔钦·布德科夫斯基表示，车队已经"实施了缓解措施"以避免类似事件再次发生。
"在赛后调查之后，瓦尔特里遭遇了悬挂故障，我们已经采取了缓解措施以防止未来再次发生,"布德科夫斯基说。"我也很高兴看到科尔顿回归MAC-26，进行另一场FP1练习，取代了切科。他在练习中的成长令人印象深刻，他的反馈对我们2027年的发展计划仍然非常宝贵。
赫塔在争取超级驾照的过程中遇到了阻碍，当他的赛车在蒙扎发生故障时，26岁的他未能达到获得积分所需的100公里阈值。在巴西，完成因特拉戈斯赛道的24圈将满足这一要求。
detailEn: Colton Herta to run Cadillac FP1 in Brazil as FIA superlicense quest continues
In Brazil, Colton Herta will aim to collect his final FIA superlicense point required to race in Formula 1 following confusion over his points tally

Cadillac test driver Colton Herta will conduct his sixth Friday practice session of the F1 season at this weekend's Sao Paulo GP to collect his missing FIA superlicense point required to race in the series.

Herta, who has been building up for an F1 campaign with private testing, FP1 sessions and a troubled F2 campaign, needs 40 points to obtain the required FIA superlicense. Cadillac believed the former IndyCar ace had reached that threshold last week in Mexico, but it soon emerged the Californian was still one point shy amid confusion over his previous IndyCar results.

Cadillac will now rectify that error by handing Herta another Friday FP1 session in Sergio Perez's car, which yields a single point. Teams are only required to run a rookie in four FP1 sessions per year, but Sao Paulo will be Herta's sixth of the season as the squad is keen for Herta to finally obtain the license.
That allows the team to keep its options open as it considers retaining incumbent Valtteri Bottas for a second year alongside Perez, or handing Herta his F1 debut in 2027.

"I’m really looking forward to getting back behind the wheel of the MAC-26 for another FP1 session," Herta said. "Interlagos is such an iconic, historic track, and driving an F1 car around there is going to be an awesome experience.

"Every time I’ve stepped into the car this year, from Barcelona to Budapest, COTA and Mexico City, I’ve felt more comfortable and better integrated with the engineering team. My goal for Friday morning in Brazil is the same: execute the run plan cleanly, give Checo and the engineers the best possible setup data to start their weekend, and keep building on my progress in the car. I’m grateful to the team for giving me this opportunity."

Cadillac heads to Brazil after a bruising Mexico weekend, which ended with Bottas suffering a high-speed crash in the race due to a sudden front-left suspension failure. Team principal Marcin Budkowski said the team had "implemented mitigations" to avoid a repeat.

"Following our post-race investigations, Valtteri suffered a suspension failure, and we have implemented mitigations going forward," Budkowski said. "I’m also pleased to see Colton return to the MAC-26 for another FP1 outing, stepping in for Checo. His growth in the car across his sessions has been impressive, and his feedback remains invaluable to our 2027 development program."

Herta's bid to obtain his superlicense hit a snag when his car broke down in Monza, leaving the 26-year-old short of the 100km threshold required for the session to award a point. In Brazil, 24 laps of the Interlagos circuit will satisfy that requirement.

detailZh: 梅赛德斯领队盛赞安东内利的大师级表现，同时承认他们辜负了乔治·拉塞尔
安德鲁·肖夫林盛赞安东内利的夺冠之路，同时为毁掉拉塞尔周日的电池故障道歉
乔治·拉塞尔，梅赛德斯，安德烈亚·基米·安东内利，梅赛德斯
致梅赛德斯车迷。来自银箭车队的最新消息，包括F1新闻、车手动态、赛车研发以及来自布拉克利和布里克斯沃思的赛事分析。
在罗德里格斯兄弟赛道的布拉克利车库，见证了赛车运动的绝对极端。周日，车队成功加冕了F1历史上最年轻的世界车手冠军，但与此同时，工程部门高层却被迫因机械故障向车库另一侧公开道歉。
墨西哥城大奖赛后，赛道工程总监安德鲁·肖夫林迅速赞扬了这位新晋冠军，并强调了极为有效的轮胎策略。这位20岁的意大利车手执行了超长的首段赛程，将软胎坚持到40圈以上，从而对场上其他车手形成了显著的战略错位。
“恭喜基米赢得他的首个世界冠军，”肖夫林赛后表示。“这是一场相当多事的比赛，但他在第一段对软胎的管理做得非常出色，能够坚持超过40圈。”
尽管第45圈的红旗抹去了这来之不易的轮胎优势，这位年轻天才在重启后并未退缩。他从第四位全力推进，干净利落地超越了法拉利的查尔斯·勒克莱尔，抢下季军，排在分站冠军马克斯·维斯塔潘和刘易斯·汉密尔顿之后，锁定了2026年的总冠军。
这位工程主管解释道：“他重新起步时排在第4位，但对勒克莱尔完成了一次非常漂亮的超越，重新回到领奖台位置，此后他跑了一场控制得非常好的比赛，拿下第3名和总冠军。整个赛季他的驾驶都非常出色，今天在一切悬而未决的情况下处理比赛的方式，再次证明了他取得的进步。”
当冠军庆祝活动在围场一侧拉开帷幕时，肖夫林对毁掉乔治·拉塞尔下午的机械失误给出了直率的评价。
这位英国车手从发车格第2位起步，却在到达第一个刹车区之前就遭遇了电池输出故障。电能的突然缺失让他在巨大的主直道上不断丢位置，彻底毁掉了他的比赛策略，最终导致他在6号弯撞转红牛的伊萨克·哈贾尔，被处以一次绝望而笨拙的10秒罚时。
肖夫林承认：“乔治这个下午很艰难，但这并非他自己的过错。在通往1号弯的路段上出现的输出问题让他丢了好几个位置，从一开始就让他陷入被动。从那以后，他不得不在车流中追赶，而与哈贾尔的接触以及随后的罚时让这项任务更加艰难。”
尽管早早打转、被罚时，又遭遇严重车流，这位老将依然保持冷静，奋力拼下一个来之不易的第六名完赛。不过，梅赛德斯维修区墙（pitwall）拒绝为电气故障找借口。
“这很令人沮丧，因为我们没给他所需要的比赛起步，这是我们车队的责任，”赛道总监坦言。
车手总冠军已稳稳收入囊中，但这家德国制造商毫无松油门的打算，围场即将收拾行装前往英特拉格斯。
“前往巴西之前，我们还有很多要专注的事情，”肖夫林总结道。“我们希望把车队总冠军也加到车手总冠军之上，我们知道仍必须拿出相应的表现才能做到。今天我们会好好享受，然后很快把注意力转向下一场比赛。”
detailEn: Mercedes boss praises Antonelli’s masterclass while admitting they failed George Russell
Andrew Shovlin praises Antonelli's title run while apologising for the battery failure that ruined Russell's Sunday
George Russell, Mercedes, Andrea Kimi Antonelli, Mercedes
For Mercedes fans. All the latest from the Silver Arrows, with F1 news, driver updates, car development and race analysis from Brackley and Brixworth.

The Brackley garage experienced the absolute extremes of motorsport at the Autodromo Hermanos Rodríguez. While the team successfully crowned the youngest world drivers' champion in Formula 1 history on Sunday, the engineering brass was simultaneously forced to publicly apologise to the other side of the garage for a mechanical failure.

Trackside Engineering Director Andrew Shovlin was quick to praise his newly minted champion following the Mexico City Grand Prix, highlighting a brutally effective tyre strategy. The 20-year-old Italian executed a massive opening stint, nursing the soft compound rubber well past the 40-lap mark to create a significant strategic offset against the rest of the grid.

"Congratulations to Kimi on his first world championship," Shovlin remarked after the race. "It was quite an eventful race, but he did a really good job managing the Soft tyre in the first stint and was able to run it beyond 40 laps."

While the Lap 45 red flag wiped out that hard-earned tyre advantage, the young prodigy did not flinch on the restart. Dropping the hammer from fourth place, he executed a clinical pass on Ferrari's Charles Leclerc to snatch a podium finish behind race winner Max Verstappen and Lewis Hamilton, sealing the 2026 crown.

"He restarted P4 but made a very good move on Leclerc to get back into the podium positions and drove a very controlled race from there to take P3 and the title," the engineering boss explained. "He has driven superbly across the season and the way he handled the race today, with everything that was at stake, was another demonstration of the progress he has made."
While the championship celebrations kicked off on one side of the paddock, Shovlin offered a blunt assessment of the mechanical blunder that ruined George Russell's afternoon.

Launching from second on the grid, the British driver suffered a battery deployment failure before ever reaching the first braking zone. The sudden lack of electrical energy caused him to bleed positions on the massive main straight, completely destroying his race strategy and ultimately leading to a desperate, clumsy 10-second penalty for spinning Red Bull's Isack Hadjar at Turn 6.

"George had a difficult afternoon through no fault of his own," Shovlin admitted. "The deployment issue on the run to Turn 1 cost him several positions and put him on the back foot from the very start. From there, he was having to recover in traffic, and the contact with Hadjar and subsequent penalty made that task harder."

Despite the early spin, the time penalty, and the heavy traffic, the veteran charger kept his composure to salvage a hard-fought sixth-place finish. Still, the Mercedes pitwall refused to make excuses for the electrical glitch.
"It’s frustrating because we didn’t give him the start to the race that he needed, and that is on us as a team," the trackside director confessed.
With the drivers' crown firmly secured, the German manufacturer has zero intention of lifting off the throttle as the paddock packs up for Interlagos.

"We have plenty to focus on as we head to Brazil," Shovlin concluded. "We want to add the Constructors’ Championship to the Drivers’ title, and we know we still must deliver the performances to do that. We’ll enjoy today, then turn our attention very quickly to the next race."

items.summaryZh: 凯迪拉克将给科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛上提供另一次练习机会，以帮助他获得最后一点积分，从而最终获得F1超级执照。尽管赫塔在墨西哥FP1的亮相原本被认为足以让他达到目标，但由于IndyCar网站上的错误，这一目标未能实现。
items.originalTitle: Herta gets another Cadillac F1 practice to earn superlicence
detailZh: 凯迪拉克将给科尔顿·赫塔在巴西大奖赛上提供另一次练习机会，以帮助他获得最后一点积分，从而最终获得F1超级执照。
这将是在本赛季中，赫塔与凯迪拉克的第六次FP1练习，他将取代塞尔吉奥·佩雷斯。车队原本只需要进行四次练习来满足新手的练习要求，但赫塔仍然缺少所需的40个超级执照积分。
尽管车队最初认为赫塔在墨西哥FP1的亮相将使他达到目标，但后来发现这是错误的，因为IndyCar网站上出现了错误。
这个错误让赫塔在IndyCar排名中从第七位变成了第六位，导致多算了两个额外的超级执照积分。
凯迪拉克今年早些时候确实确认了与FIA的错误计算，但在墨西哥大奖赛周末，赫塔需要再进行一节练习才能获得40分。
赫塔在2023年IndyCar中取得第10名获得1分，2024年取得亚军获得30分，2025年取得第7名获得4分，加上四个FP1赛段的积分（赫塔在蒙扎的里程不足，无法获得超级驾照积分），目前他共有39分。
凯迪拉克原本计划在年底前让赫塔再进行一节FP1练习，因为他是有望在下赛季接替瓦尔特里·博塔斯的车队主要竞争者之一。
但如果没有超级驾照，他就无法获得那个座位，所以凯迪拉克在第一个机会下为他完成最后所需的积分是一个合理的举动。
他在巴西获得积分也没有保证——因为他还需要在FP1中至少完成24圈才能达到必要的100公里以获得积分。
凯迪拉克在墨西哥遭遇了严重的可靠性问题，当时瓦尔特里·博塔斯的左前悬挂突然失效。
车队正在调查问题的原因，因为今年早些时候佩雷斯的车上也出现过类似的问题。
detailEn: Cadillac will give Colton Herta another practice outing at the Brazilian Grand Prix to earn him the last point he needs to finally secure his Formula 1 superlicence.

This will be Herta's sixth FP1 outing of the season with Cadillac and he'll replace Sergio Perez. The team only needed to do four to satisfy the rookie practice requirements - but Herta's still short of the 40 superlicence points needed.
That's despite the team initially believing Herta's Mexico FP1 appearance would get him there, which turned out to be wrong because of an error on IndyCar's website.
That error had Herta sixth in the IndyCar standings instead of seventh, creating a miscalculation of two extra superlicence points.
Cadillac did verify that erroneous calculation with the FIA earlier this year but it emerged over the Mexico GP weekend that Herta would need another session to get to 40 points.

Herta picks up one point for finishing 10th in IndyCar in 2023, 30 points for finishing runner-up in 2024, and four points for being seventh in 2025, which, with points for four FP1s (Herta didn't complete enough mileage at Monza to get the superlicence point), leaves him with 39 points currently.
Cadillac was already planning to run Herta in another FP1 session before the end of the year as he's one of the leading contenders to replace Valtteri Bottas in the team next season.
But he can't get that seat if he doesn't have a superlicence, so Cadillac ticking off the last point he needs at the first available opportunity is a logical move.
There's no guarantee he'll get the point in Brazil either - as he'll still need to complete at least 24 laps in FP1 to reach the necessary 100km to earn the point.
Cadillac suffered a major reliability issue in Mexico when Valtteri Bottas's front-left suspension failed dramatically.
The team is investigating the cause of the issue, having experienced similar problems on Perez's car earlier this year.
